A '''constabulary officer''' was a political prisoner at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the [[Liberation of Stars' End]], the [[stasis booth]]s began to shut down and the prisoners started to emerge. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] recognized the uniform of a planetary constabulary, and requested the officer assist with the ordering of the prisoners. During the breakout, he and a few prisoners held a upper landing in the stairwell against an [[Security Police/Legends|Espo]] strike. He also dispatched a few defenders to a lower landing as lookouts.
